title: Ramen Eggs (Ajitsuke Tamago) (Video) • Just One Cookbook
snippet: Ramen eggs are Japanese soft-boiled eggs known for their custardy, jammy, runny yolk, and umami flavor. They are marinated overnight in a sweetened soy-based sauce.
